CustomProperties.Name: AcceptedText
CustomProperties.Tooltip: File types named in the hint line under the dropzone. The size limit is appended from MaxFileSize, so do not type it here. Purely cosmetic, the Attachments control does not enforce a type filter.

CustomProperties.Name: AllowDelete
CustomProperties.Tooltip: PERMISSION. The bin on each existing document row. False leaves a list the user can read, preview, download and add to, but not remove from, which is the usual shape when everyone contributes and only an owner deletes. Independent of AllowUpload; the four combinations of the two are all meaningful.

CustomProperties.Name: AllowUpload
CustomProperties.Tooltip: PERMISSION AND LAYOUT AT ONCE. The dropzone and the Upload and Cancel buttons. False when the user may not add documents, and equally when uploading lives behind a button elsewhere on the screen and you simply want the zone out of the way. Existing rows keep their view and download icons either way.

CustomProperties.Name: Colors
CustomProperties.Tooltip: All ten keys are required. A missing key resolves blank and paints nothing with no error. DropBorder and DropFill are the dashed upload zone. RowFill and RowBorder are a document row. Accent is the Download All link.

CustomProperties.Name: DesiredHeight
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Header plus dropzone plus both lists plus footer for the current flags and row counts. Bind the instance Height to this, or let a parent AutoLayout stretch the instance instead.

CustomProperties.Name: DocCount
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Row count of Items, the documents that already exist. Does not include staged files.

CustomProperties.Name: HeaderText
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Heading above the dropzone. ShowHeader false hides it.

CustomProperties.Name: Items
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Documents that ALREADY EXIST. The component does not query anything, so it carries no connector dependency. Schema is Id, Name, SizeBytes, UploadedOn, UploadedBy, Ext. SizeBytes is a number of bytes, not a formatted string, because the footer totals it. Ext drives the coloured type tile and is matched against TypeColors case insensitively.

CustomProperties.Name: MaxFiles
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Cap on STAGED files, enforced in OnAddFile and passed to the Attachments control. Existing documents in Items are not counted against it.

CustomProperties.Name: MaxFileSize
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Megabytes. Shown in the hint line AND passed to the Attachments control's MaxAttachmentSize, so it is genuinely enforced at the point of staging. Decimal MB, meaning 1,000,000 bytes, which is how the control counts. There is a platform ceiling above this near 50MB regardless of what you set. A Flow side check is still worth having, since this one only guards the picker.

CustomProperties.Name: OnCancel
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Fires after the staged list is cleared. The clear happens inside the component, so a handler only has to close whatever is hosting it.

CustomProperties.Name: OnDelete
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Fires when the bin icon on an EXISTING document is tapped. Read TappedId and TappedName. The component removes nothing, deletion is the caller's to own. This is a natural place to call a Flow, or to show your own confirm dialog first and call it from there.

CustomProperties.Name: OnDownload
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Fires when the download icon on an existing document is tapped. Read TappedId and TappedName. Call Download() on a URL you already hold, or run a Flow that returns one.

CustomProperties.Name: OnDownloadAll
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Fires when the footer Download All link is tapped. Usually a Flow that zips the library folder and returns a link.

CustomProperties.Name: OnSave
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Fires when Upload is tapped. Read StagedFiles in the handler and hand it to a Flow. The component does NOT clear the staged list, because the caller has to know the upload succeeded first. Call Reset() on the instance once it has.

CustomProperties.Name: OnView
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Fires when the eye icon on an existing document is tapped. Read TappedId and TappedName.

CustomProperties.Name: ShowFooter
CustomProperties.Tooltip: The count and total size line, and the Download All link.

CustomProperties.Name: ShowHeader
CustomProperties.Tooltip: The HeaderText line.

CustomProperties.Name: ShowRowActions
CustomProperties.Tooltip: The view, download and bin icons on each existing document row.

CustomProperties.Name: StagedCount
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Number of files staged but not yet saved.

CustomProperties.Name: StagedFiles
CustomProperties.Tooltip: The staged attachments, in whatever shape the Attachments control produced. Read this inside OnSave and hand it to a Flow. It is NOT cleared on save, see OnSave.

CustomProperties.Name: StagedFilesData
CustomProperties.Tooltip: A TABLE of { Name, ContentBytes } with clean base64. POPULATED WHEN UPLOAD IS PRESSED and only meaningful inside the OnSave handler. Use this when your Flow takes a TEXT parameter. Loop it with ForAll for a one-file-per-run Flow, or wrap it in JSON() for a Flow that takes the whole batch at once. If your Flow's trigger has a FILE input instead, send StagedFiles and skip base64 entirely.

CustomProperties.Name: Style
CustomProperties.Tooltip: All eleven keys are required. DropHeight is the dashed zone. RowHeight must exceed TileSize. ActionSize is one icon button, three sit at the right of a row. The four Size keys are pixels, this is a React family component.

CustomProperties.Name: TappedId
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Id of the document whose row action was last tapped. Only meaningful inside OnView, OnDownload or OnDelete.

CustomProperties.Name: TappedName
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Name of the document whose row action was last tapped.

CustomProperties.Name: TotalBytes
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Sum of SizeBytes across Items. Staged files are excluded, because the Attachments control does not expose a reliable size.

CustomProperties.Name: TotalText
CustomProperties.Tooltip: TotalBytes formatted the same way a row is, KB under a megabyte and MB above.

CustomProperties.Name: TypeColors
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Maps a file extension to the colour of its tile. Ext is matched against Items.Ext case insensitively. A row with Ext default is REQUIRED and catches every unmapped extension. Fill is the tile, Text is the three or four letters on it.

CustomProperties.Name: AssignmentKey
CustomProperties.Tooltip: The AssignmentKey of the task being completed. The component looks the record up in the RequestAssignments LIST itself, on the indexed AssignmentKey, so nothing else about the task needs passing in. It reads the list rather than a collection because this component has instances on BOTH My Tasks and Details, so it must not depend on any one screen's state.

CustomProperties.Name: Comment
CustomProperties.Tooltip: The comment the user typed. Read this in OnSubmit and pass it to the flow.

CustomProperties.Name: OnCancel
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Fires when the user dismisses the dialog by the scrim, the close button or Cancel. Clear your open flag here AND call Reset() on this instance, or the next open still shows this task's outcome.

CustomProperties.Name: OnSubmit
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Fires when the user confirms. Read OutcomeKey and Comment and call your flow from here, then call Reset() on this instance once the dialog closes. The component never calls a flow and never writes to a data source.

CustomProperties.Name: OutcomeKey
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Approve, Reject or SendBack. These are OutcomeKey keys AS STORED, never the display labels, and never the past tense: this description said Approved, Rejected, SentBack, which are values nothing in the app or the flow recognises. The control code has always emitted the correct three. Skipped is engine only and is deliberately not offered.

CustomProperties.Name: DraftPhases
CustomProperties.Tooltip: The edited phase draft, including IsRemoved rows. Read this in OnSave and hand the whole thing to your flow or patch it locally. IsRemoved rows must survive to the payload or the receiver cannot tell a deletion from a row that was never there.

CustomProperties.Name: DraftWorkers
CustomProperties.Tooltip: The edited assignment draft, including IsRemoved rows. ClientId and PhaseClientId are LOCAL JOIN COLUMNS and must be stripped by the receiver, never persisted.

CustomProperties.Name: IsDirty
CustomProperties.Tooltip: True once anything in the draft has changed. Use it to guard navigation away from an unsaved edit.

CustomProperties.Name: LoadDraft
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Builds the draft from the RequestPhases and RequestAssignments LISTS for RequestKey, both delegated on the indexed RequestKey. Call this when you open the dialog. A component has no OnVisible, so nothing inside can notice it became visible.

CustomProperties.Name: LoadTemplate
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Appends the phases and assignments of SeedTemplateKey to the draft, keeping any Completed phase. Call it straight after LoadDraft when a request starts from a category template. Does nothing when SeedTemplateKey is blank or names no template, so an existing request can call it unconditionally.

CustomProperties.Name: OnCancel
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Fires when the user abandons the edit. The draft is already cleared by the time this runs, so just clear your open flag.

CustomProperties.Name: OnSave
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Fires when the user confirms. Read DraftPhases and DraftWorkers and do the write from here. The component never writes to a data source and never calls a flow, which is what lets the same component serve a collection-only build and a flow-backed one.

CustomProperties.Name: Rebuild
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Reprojects the flat row list. Only needed if the host mutates the draft collections directly; every control inside the component already calls it.

CustomProperties.Name: RequestKey
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Which request to load. The component reads the RequestPhases and RequestAssignments LISTS itself, scoped to this key.

CustomProperties.Name: RequireResolved
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Whether Save waits for every assignment to have a person or a group. True for an existing request, where an unresolved row would reach a flow that cannot action it. False for a brand new request, where the draft is still local, nothing is written until Create, and the template's role names are the point of the template.

CustomProperties.Name: SeedTemplateKey
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Which template LoadTemplate appends. Blank is the normal value for an existing request. A new request sets this from its category's DefaultTemplateKey.

CustomProperties.Name: UnresolvedCount
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Assignments with neither an email nor a group. A template row carries a role name and nothing else, and a flow cannot action one. Save is already gated on this internally; the output is for your own messaging.

CustomProperties.Name: Body
CustomProperties.Tooltip: The finished HTML body. Read this in OnSend and hand it to your mail action. Note is escaped before it goes in here.

CustomProperties.Name: Busy
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Set this true from the host while your send is running and false when it finishes. The dialog disables every control and shows a sending state. The component never sets it itself, because the component does not know when your send is done.

CustomProperties.Name: CcAddresses
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Semicolon separated. Blank addresses dropped, duplicates collapsed, and anyone already on the To line removed. Blank when nobody was CCd.

CustomProperties.Name: Config
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Look and behaviour. Theme is light or dark. Accent is a hex string, blank falls back to blue. MaxNote caps the note length. ShowPriority and ShowCc hide those sections entirely.

CustomProperties.Name: ContextHtml
CustomProperties.Tooltip: HTML placed above the note in the body. Use it for a record summary. Passed through untouched, so escape it yourself if it contains user typed text.

CustomProperties.Name: ContextLine
CustomProperties.Tooltip: One short line shown under the dialog title, so the sender can see what the mail is about. Not sent.

CustomProperties.Name: DefaultSubject
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Prefills the subject box. With Config.LockSubject true it becomes read only, which is what you want when a reply has to be traceable back to a record.

CustomProperties.Name: Directory
CustomProperties.Tooltip: The people the pickers offer. Needs DisplayName and Mail columns; JobTitle is shown when present. Ships with sample rows so the component works on paste with no setup. Swap in your own table or a live directory search.

CustomProperties.Name: Note
CustomProperties.Tooltip: The plain text the sender typed, trimmed and unescaped. Log this rather than Body, which is markup.

CustomProperties.Name: OnCancel

CustomProperties.Name: ActionKey
CustomProperties.Tooltip: The GroupKey or ItemKey of the row whose action was just pressed. Read it inside OnMoveUp, OnMoveDown, OnEdit or OnDelete, alongside ActionRowType.

CustomProperties.Tooltip: Whether the last action came from a group row or a child row. The literal text group or item, so your handler can branch without guessing.

CustomProperties.Name: Config
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Look and behaviour. Every field is Coalesced internally against the defaults below, because a pasted instance receives a BLANK record and an unguarded read would hide every switch at once. Theme is light or dark. Accent is a hex string, blank falls back to blue. Radius rounds the cards. RowHeight sets every row. ShowHeader, ShowTags and ShowMeta hide those pieces entirely, which is what you want on a narrow screen. ShowExpandAll shows the expand-all toggle in the header. AllowReorder, AllowEdit and AllowDelete turn the row actions on and off; with all three false the component is a pure viewer and reserves no space for them.

CustomProperties.Name: ExpandedGroupKey
CustomProperties.Tooltip: The GroupKey currently open, or blank when everything is collapsed. One group opens at a time.

CustomProperties.Name: GroupCount
CustomProperties.Tooltip: How many groups were passed in.

CustomProperties.Name: Groups
CustomProperties.Tooltip: The parent rows. Needs GroupKey (number, unique and never zero, since zero means nothing-expanded), GroupOrder (number), Marker, Title, Subtitle, Tag, Tone, Meta and Locked. Locked true hides every row action on that row, which is how you express a record the user may look at but not change. Tone is one of positive, warning, danger, info or blank for neutral. Meta is yours to compute; leave it blank and the component counts the children instead. Ships with sample rows so it works on paste with no setup.

CustomProperties.Name: IsExpandAll
CustomProperties.Tooltip: True while every group is open. ExpandedGroupKey is blank in that state, because no single group is the open one.

CustomProperties.Name: ItemCount
CustomProperties.Tooltip: How many child rows were passed in, across every group.

CustomProperties.Name: Items
CustomProperties.Tooltip: The child rows. Needs ItemKey (number, unique), GroupKey matching a row in Groups, ItemOrder (number), Marker, Title, Subtitle, Tag, Tone, Meta and Locked. Same column shape as Groups on purpose, so one record projection serves both.

CustomProperties.Name: OnDelete

CustomProperties.Name: OnEdit
CustomProperties.Tooltip: The edit action was pressed. Read ActionKey and ActionRowType and open your own editor.

CustomProperties.Name: OnMoveDown
CustomProperties.Tooltip: The move-down action was pressed. Read ActionKey and ActionRowType and renumber your own data. The component never reorders anything, because Groups and Items are inputs and it has nothing to write to.

CustomProperties.Name: OnMoveUp
CustomProperties.Tooltip: The move-up action was pressed. Read ActionKey and ActionRowType and renumber your own data. The button is already disabled on the first row of its scope, so you do not have to guard the edges.

ComponentTemplates.ComponentDescription: Progress stepper with bar and circle modes. Labels, connectors, sizes, themes, and jump-to-step navigation built in.

CustomProperties.Name: AccentColor
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Active and complete highlight color

CustomProperties.Name: CheckIcon
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Optional SVG data URI to replace the default checkmark. Use currentColor as stroke/fill token.

CustomProperties.Name: ClickableSteps
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Completed allows tapping done steps only. None disables all tapping. All allows jumping to any step.

CustomProperties.Name: CurrentStep
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Active step index (1-based)

CustomProperties.Name: Density
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Full shows circles with labels and connectors. Compact hides labels. Minimal hides labels and connectors. Only applies when Type is Step.

CustomProperties.Name: OnStepSelect
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Fires when a step circle is tapped. Read SelectedStep inside handler.

CustomProperties.Name: SelectedStep
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Step index last tapped by the user

CustomProperties.Name: Size
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Small, Medium, or Large. Scales circle size, bar height, and component height.

CustomProperties.Name: StepLabels
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Table of {Label} rows, one per step. Count drives TotalSteps automatically.

CustomProperties.Name: Theme
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Light or Dark. Controls connector, future circle, and label colors.

CustomProperties.Name: Type
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Bar for thin progress bars, Step for numbered circles with labels

CustomProperties.Name: Colors
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Chrome only. State colors live in StateMap, not here. All five keys are required, a missing key resolves blank and paints nothing with no error. Ring is the halo drawn around every node, set it to whatever sits behind the rail or the nodes will look cut out. Track is the UNFILLED rail, drawn under every segment at full width, with the state fill painted over it to the TrackFill fraction.

CustomProperties.Name: CurrentStep
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Order of the first step whose mapped row has IsCurrent true. 0 when none does, which is the right answer for a not started or a finished run.

CustomProperties.Name: CurrentTitle
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Title of the first step whose mapped row has IsCurrent true. Blank when none does.

CustomProperties.Name: DesiredHeight
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Content height for the current Show flags and Style. Bind the instance Height to this. The component draws no padding and no card, so a caller wanting one wraps the instance rather than configuring it.

CustomProperties.Name: HeaderText
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Left hand line above the rail. The caller owns this string, so the component carries no domain vocabulary. ShowHeader false hides it and the step counter with it.

CustomProperties.Name: PercentDone
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Steps whose mapped row has CountsAsDone true, as a whole number percent of all steps. 0 when there are no steps. Rounded down, so 100 means every step is genuinely done.

CustomProperties.Name: PercentSuffix
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Appended to PercentDone in the right hand label.

CustomProperties.Name: ResolvedSteps
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Steps sorted by Order and joined to StateMap, carrying Label, NodeColor, TrackColor, Emphasize, CountsAsDone and IsCurrent. The join happens once here rather than four times in the template. Exposed because it is the thing to inspect when a rail paints wrong.

CustomProperties.Name: ShowEndLabels
CustomProperties.Tooltip: First and last step Title beneath the rail. The last label hides itself when there is only one step.

CustomProperties.Name: ShowHeader
CustomProperties.Tooltip: The HeaderText line and the step counter beside it.

CustomProperties.Name: ShowNodes
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Dots at each step boundary. False leaves a plain segmented bar and takes the hover tooltips with it, since the tooltip lives on the node hit area.

CustomProperties.Name: ShowPercent
CustomProperties.Tooltip: The right hand percent label.

CustomProperties.Name: StateMap
CustomProperties.Tooltip: One row per state in the caller's own vocabulary. State is matched against Steps.State case insensitively. Label is the tooltip suffix when a step supplies no Detail. NodeColor and TrackColor are Color typed, so theme tokens pass straight in. TrackFill is how much of that segment the state fill covers, 0 to 1, and it is what keeps the bar honest against the percent, because a step in progress should be a fraction of a segment rather than a whole one. Emphasize grows the node. CountsAsDone drives PercentDone. IsCurrent drives CurrentStep and CurrentTitle. A row with State default is REQUIRED and is the fallback for any unmatched value, matching the convention in nfTableStatus. Set IsCurrent on exactly one state, or CurrentStep reports whichever matching step sorts first by Order.

CustomProperties.Name: Steps
CustomProperties.Tooltip: One row per step. Order sorts the rail and prefixes the tooltip. Title is the step name. State is a key looked up in StateMap. Detail is an optional per step tooltip suffix that overrides the mapped Label, for when one step needs wording the state alone does not carry.

CustomProperties.Name: Style
CustomProperties.Tooltip: All eleven keys are required. RailHeight is the gallery viewport and therefore the hover target, so it must exceed NodeCurrentSize. NodeGap is the space between segments. StackGap separates the three rows. NodeRing is the halo thickness. StepWidth is the fixed width of the step counter, which is fixed so the header text beside it can take every remaining pixel instead of being clipped. The three Size keys are pixels, this is a React family component.

CustomProperties.Name: TotalSteps
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Row count of Steps.

CustomProperties.Name: AccentColor
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Primary accent color for selected items, badges, and highlights.

CustomProperties.Name: AppLogo
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Logo image for the header mark. When blank, shows the first letter of AppName.

CustomProperties.Name: AppName
CustomProperties.Tooltip: First word of the app name shown in the header when expanded.

CustomProperties.Name: AppNameAccent
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Second word of the app name rendered in AccentColor. e.g. "UI".

CustomProperties.Name: Expanded
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Initial expanded state on load. On screen OnVisible run Set(_cmpNavIsExpanded true); Set(_cmpNavSelID 11); ClearCollect(colNavExpanded {ID:1})

CustomProperties.Name: Icons
CustomProperties.Tooltip: SVG icon library as a table of {Name, SVG} pairs. Reference icons in Items by name string e.g. Icon:"Grid". SVGs use stroke='white' so they work on both dark and light icon backgrounds. Extend with your own icons — any Heroicons or Lucide SVG with stroke='white' works.

CustomProperties.Name: IsExpanded
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Mirrors Expanded. Use to offset your screen content — e.g. X = cmpSidebar.Width.

CustomProperties.Name: Items
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Table driving the nav. Schema: {ID:Number, Title:Text, Icon:Image, Letter:Text, Badge:Number, BadgeColor:Color, BadgeDot:Boolean, IsSection:Boolean, ParentID:Number, Visible:Boolean} Icon accepts an Image value or a base64 SVG data URI string cast to Image. Letter overrides the auto-initial fallback when Icon is blank — e.g. Letter:"DB" shows "DB". Set IsSection=true for divider/label rows. Set Badge=0 to hide badge. BadgeColor overrides the badge fill per item — defaults to AccentColor. BadgeDot=true shows a small dot instead of the number (good for unread indicators). Set ParentID to the parent item's ID for child items, or -1 for root level. Set Visible=false to hide an item — useful for role-based access. Sections are automatically hidden when all of their child items are hidden.
